## Summary of Changes

Brief description of what this PR introduces or fixes.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `infra`: Infrastructure or CI/CD update

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] `make lint` passed cleanly without errors or warnings
- [ ] `make test` passed cleanly with unit test coverage
- [ ] All code follows type annotations and docstring standards
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits format
